title: Is It Good Data for Multilingual Instruction Tuning or Just Bad Multilingual Evaluation for Large Language Models?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of LLMs fine-tuned and evaluated on natively authored multilingual instruction data versus machine-translated data to identify translation artifacts and performance gaps.
Using round-trip translation (translating native data to English and back) to isolate and measure the impact of missing language-specific cultural knowledge versus pure translation errors.
